svg.title: Strim vs rapid-mlx vs mlx-vlm vs mlx-lm vs oMLX: speed-up per measurement
svg.desc: Dot chart on a log scale. Each row is one measurement; the circle is Strim relative to rapid-mlx, the diamond is Strim relative to mlx-vlm, the square is Strim relative to mlx-lm, the triangle is Strim relative to oMLX, 1x meaning equal and right meaning Strim is faster. The badge reads WIN, TIE or LOSS against the best rival, or not claimable. Summary: vs rapid-mlx: 22 wins, 5 ties, 2 losses; vs mlx-vlm: 17 wins, 6 ties, 6 losses; vs mlx-lm: 27 wins, 2 ties, 0 losses; vs omlx: 14 wins, 0 ties, 0 losses.
svg.text: Log scale. 1× = equal; the shaded strip is the 2% tie band. Seconds are inverted so that right is always better.
